festivals: Patham Udaya Mahotsavam (annual, 10th day of the Malayalam month Medam; the Kumbhaka/Kumbhakuta Mahotsav with Garudan Thookkam at night)
Annual 10-day festival in the Malayalam month of Meenam, ending with the Arattu (ritual bath) of the idol

history.period: Ancient shrine; exact age undocumented in the sources consulted
history.summary: The Pallipurathukavu Devi Temple (Pallippurathu Kavu) is an ancient shrine dedicated to Goddess Bhadrakali/Durga, worshipped locally as Pallippurathamma, situated at Chandakadavu near Kodimatha in Kottayam town, Kerala. Built in traditional Kerala-style architecture, it is known for its vibrant Patham Udaya Mahotsavam on the 10th day of Medam - the Kumbhaka Mahotsav - which draws large crowds for the Garudan Thookkam ritual performed at night, and for the traditional ritual art form Thiyyattu. Unique offerings include Thulabharam (weighing oneself against rice, sugar, coconut, banana etc.), Udayasthamana Pooja (continuous sunrise-to-sunset worship), Chuttuvilakku, Karthika Vilakku and Nadel Thiyattu. NOTE: no documented founding history or dynastic attribution was found in any source consulted; sources conflict on daily timings (5 AM-12 noon / 5:30-8 PM vs 7 AM-9 PM) - verify before visiting.

name: Pallipurathukavu Devi Temple
town_description: Kottayam is the headquarters of Kottayam district in central Kerala, on the MC Road corridor between Kochi and Thiruvananthapuram; the temple stands at Chandakadavu/Kodimatha in the southern part of the town, near the District Tourism Promotion Council office.

travel.airport: Cochin International Airport, about 88 km away.
travel.railway: Kottayam railway station, about 2.5 km away.
travel.road: Next to MC Road at Kodimatha/Chandakadavu, Kottayam town; reachable by city bus, auto-rickshaw or taxi from Kottayam station.

visitor_information.best_time: September to February; Friday special poojas (Nei Vilakku, Naranga Vilakku) are popular as it is a Devi temple.
visitor_information.opening_hours: Reported as 5:00 AM to 12:00 noon and 5:30 PM to 8:00 PM daily; one source lists 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM - verify before visiting.
